description: PS - MAPPA 9 - PARCHEGGI DI STRUTTURA is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Toscana. Piano Strutturale del Comune di Firenze: parcheggi di struttura - livello rappresentato nelle mappa 9 Mobilità; stato vigente, completezza cronologica, abilitato alla consultazione cronologica. Il Piano Strutturale 2010 è stato adottato il 13.12.2010 con DCC 00057/2010, approvato il 22.06.2011 con DCC 00036/2011, reso efficace con la pubblicazione sul BURT 31 del 03.08.2011. Coverage: Regione Toscana. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Toscana. Its tags are comune-firenze, coperturadelsuolo, eu, opendata, urbanistica. It offers 1 resource(s) in WMS. The portal shows 2026-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
